title: Talc: FDA Review, IARC Reclassification & Regulatory Intelligence
excerpt: Comprehensive regulatory intelligence on talc (magnesium silicate), covering FDA expert panel recommendations, IARC Group 2A reclassification, EU Category 1B carcinogen classification, the J&J litigation, asbestos contamination testing, MoCRA implications, and state-level bans on talc in menstrual products.
seo_title: Talc Regulatory Intelligence | FDA, IARC, EU Classification & J&J Litigation | Policy Canary
seo_description: Regulatory intelligence on talc. IARC reclassified to Group 2A (probably carcinogenic). EU classifying as Category 1B carcinogen — cosmetics ban expected ~2027. FDA expert panel recommends removal from food and drugs. New York bans talc in menstrual products (Dec 2026). 59,571 pending J&J claims.

key_deadlines.label: IARC reclassifies talc from Group 2B to Group 2A (probably carcinogenic)
ECHA RAC classifies talc as Category 1B carcinogen under CLP Regulation
FDA Expert Panel on talc — panelists unanimously support removing talc from food and drugs
FDA withdraws proposed asbestos testing rule for talc cosmetics
New York Governor signs S.1548 banning talc in menstrual products
New York talc ban in menstrual products takes effect
Expected EU ban on talc in cosmetics following CLP 1B classification
